title: ChatRequest
description: A natural-language design request from the browser. project_id is REQUIRED: every request is explicitly project-scoped (see .kiro/steering/security.md project isolation). request_id is REQUIRED and is the stable identity of this submission: the client assigns it once and reuses it verbatim when retrying, so a retry executes the mutation once while a genuinely new submission of the same instruction executes again. String identifiers must be non-blank: `minLength` alone would admit whitespace-only values, so a `\S` pattern is required alongside it.

request_id.description: Stable submission identity. Reused verbatim on retry; regenerated for a new intentional command.

selected_object_id.description: Optional browser-selected object the user is referring to.
